mentions.name: kubehub.io
mentions.description: This platform lets users build a private cloud on their own hardware and manage it through Kubernetes with an easy-to-use interface, automating on-prem setup work such as ingress/gateway, DNS, TLS, and monitoring.
mentions.problem: Kubernetes on-prem setup takes a lot of work; even after the cluster is up, there is still tons of work to set up ingress/gateway, DNS, TLS, and monitoring.
